en.name: Piazza Grande
en.text: The central square of Modena, part of the UNESCO heritage and the heart of the city's public life.

en.name: Palazzo Ducale di Modena
en.text: A Baroque palace that once housed the Dukes of Este and is now the seat of the Military Academy.

en.text: A futuristic museum dedicated to the life and work of Enzo Ferrari, located at his birthplace.

en.name: Galleria Estense
en.text: Houses the valuable art collection of the Dukes of Este, including works by Velázquez and El Greco.

en.name: Mercato Albinelli
en.text: A beautiful historic covered market in Art Nouveau style, famous for local food and atmosphere.

en.name: Teatro Comunale Luciano Pavarotti
en.text: The city's opera house, named after the world-famous tenor who was born here in Modena.

en.name: Parco Giardino Ducale Estense
en.text: The former garden of the Ducal Palace, now a well-kept public park in Modena's city centre.

en.name: Abbazia di San Pietro
en.text: An ancient monastic complex with a magnificent facade and impressive Renaissance terracotta sculptures.

descriptionAdvanced.de: Modena ist weltweit als Herz des 'Motor Valley' bekannt, da hier die Firmengeschichten von Ferrari und Maserati fest verwurzelt sind. Das Enzo Ferrari Museum ist ein Muss für Automobilfans. Doch Modena bietet weit mehr als Technik: Die Piazza Grande mit dem romanischen Dom und dem schlanken Ghirlandina-Turm gehört zum UNESCO-Welterbe und gilt als eines der schönsten Beispiele mittelalterlicher Baukunst in Italien. In den Dachböden der Palazzi reift der wertvolle Aceto Balsamico Tradizionale, der Stolz der Region. Modena ist zudem die Heimat des Tenors Luciano Pavarotti, dessen Erbe in der Stadt omnipräsent ist. Die Markthalle 'Albinelli' bietet Einblicke in die authentische Esskultur der Emilia, von Tortellini bis zu lokalem Lambrusco-Wein.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Modena az a város, ahol a technikai tökéletesség és a középkori művészet kéz a kézben jár. Világszerte a 'Motor-völgy' központjaként ismerik, hiszen innen indult a Ferrari és a Maserati története; az Enzo Ferrari Múzeum a modern építészet és az autósport szerelmeseinek zarándokhelye. A város szíve azonban a 12. századi Dóm és a mellé épült Ghirlandina-torony, amely a Piazza Grandéval együtt az UNESCO Világörökség része. A gasztronómia itt vallás: a padlásokon érlelődő hagyományos balzsamecet (Aceto Balsamico Tradizionale) készítése évszázados családi rituálé. Modena szülötte Luciano Pavarotti is, akinek emlékét a róla elnevezett operaház őrzi. Az Albinelli piac lüktetése és a környékbeli Lambrusco borok az igazi olasz életérzést közvetítik.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Modena este cunoscută în întreaga lume ca inima regiunii 'Motor Valley', fiind locul unde istoria companiilor Ferrari și Maserati este profund înrădăcinată. Muzeul Enzo Ferrari este o destinație obligatorie pentru fanii automobilelor. Totuși, Modena oferă mult mai mult decât tehnologie: Piazza Grande, cu catedrala sa romanică și turnul zvelt Ghirlandina, face parte din patrimoniul UNESCO și este considerată unul dintre cele mai frumoase exemple de arhitectură medievală din Italia. În mansardele palatelor se maturează prețiosul Aceto Balsamico Tradizionale, mândria regiunii. Modena este, de asemenea, orașul natal al tenorului Luciano Pavarotti, a cărui moștenire este omniprezentă. Piața acoperită 'Albinelli' oferă o privire asupra culturii culinare autentice din Emilia, de la tortellini la vinul local Lambrusco.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Modena is globally recognized as the heart of 'Motor Valley,' as the histories of Ferrari and Maserati are deeply rooted here. The Enzo Ferrari Museum is a must for automotive enthusiasts. However, Modena offers far more than just technology: Piazza Grande, with its Romanesque cathedral and the slender Ghirlandina tower, is a UNESCO World Heritage site and one of the finest examples of medieval architecture in Italy. In the attics of local palaces, the precious Aceto Balsamico Tradizionale matures, the pride of the region. Modena is also the home of tenor Luciano Pavarotti, whose legacy is omnipresent throughout the city. The 'Albinelli' market provides insight into the authentic culinary culture of Emilia, from tortellini to local Lambrusco wine.
